title.zh-CN: 逐渐增大的阴囊肿物 · 40岁男性

text.zh-CN: 左阴囊多发实性肿块，约7.0×3.6 cm，与睾丸分界尚清，怀疑阴囊软组织来源。
text.en: Multiple solid left scrotal masses, approximately 7.0×3.6 cm, relatively distinct from the testis, suggesting a scrotal soft-tissue origin.

text.zh-CN: 左阴囊混合密度肿块，较大者约4.1×4.3×5.4 cm，少量积液；扫描范围未见转移灶。影像未确立良恶性。
text.en: Mixed-density left scrotal masses, the largest about 4.1×4.3×5.4 cm, with a small fluid collection; no metastasis was seen within the scan range. Imaging did not establish benignity or malignancy.

name.zh-CN: 调阅肿瘤标志物与激素

zh-CN: 调阅肿瘤标志物与激素

text.zh-CN: β-hCG<0.2 mIU/mL，PSA等未报告异常升高；FSH 8.2 IU/L、LH 4.47 IU/L、睾酮8.28 nmol/L。原文概述激素正常但未列参考范围；AFP/LDH具体结果缺失。
text.en: β-hCG <0.2 mIU/mL, with no reported PSA elevation; FSH 8.2 IU/L, LH 4.47 IU/L and testosterone 8.28 nmol/L. The report summarised hormones as normal without ranges; specific AFP/LDH results are missing.

name.zh-CN: 调阅切除标本病理及免疫组化

zh-CN: 调阅切除标本病理及免疫组化

text.zh-CN: 历史手术为左高位睾丸切除。术后见硬化性纤维胶原增生和炎细胞浸润，倾向纤维性假瘤。Calretinin阳性、BerEP4阴性；IgG4局部>50/HPF但IgG4/IgG<20%，周围睾丸附睾精索无明显病变。
text.en: The historical operation was a left high inguinal orchiectomy. Histology showed sclerotic collagenous proliferation and inflammation, favouring fibrous pseudotumour. Calretinin was positive and BerEP4 negative; local IgG4-positive cells exceeded 50/HPF but IgG4/IgG was <20%, with no clear surrounding testicular, epididymal or cord lesion.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 原报告记录高位切除后病理倾向纤维性假瘤，作者反思进一步术前影像和术中冰冻可能帮助避免不必要切除。未提供本例MRI、冰冻结果、长期复发情况、术后激素或生育结局，不能补写治愈或功能完整。
text.en: The report records orchiectomy followed by pathology favouring fibrous pseudotumour. The authors reflected that additional preoperative imaging and frozen section may help avoid unnecessary resection. No patient-specific MRI, frozen section, long-term recurrence, postoperative hormonal or fertility outcome is provided.

text.zh-CN: 多发阴囊实性病变，可能睾旁来源，性质仍需组织学及专科评估
text.en: Multiple solid scrotal lesions, possibly paratesticular, requiring tissue and specialist assessment of their nature

feedback.zh-CN: 影像定位和不高的标志物不能独立排除恶性；本例正文与讨论对术前排除肿瘤的表述不一致，应保留不确定性。
feedback.en: Location and non-elevated markers do not independently exclude malignancy; the report’s preoperative statements are inconsistent and uncertainty must be retained.

text.zh-CN: 标志物不高即可排除恶性并直接确诊纤维性假瘤
text.en: Non-elevated markers exclude malignancy and directly establish fibrous pseudotumour

feedback.zh-CN: 影像定位和不高的标志物不能独立排除恶性；本例正文与讨论对术前排除肿瘤的表述不一致，应保留不确定性。
feedback.en: Location and non-elevated markers do not independently exclude malignancy; the report’s preoperative statements are inconsistent and uncertainty must be retained.

prompt.zh-CN: 结合术后病理，应怎样复盘并规划后续？
prompt.en: How should postoperative pathology guide review and further planning?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 泌尿与病理团队核对良性纤维性病变并个体化随访；类似未手术病例可讨论进一步定位及保器官评估，不能倒推本例一定适合某术式
text.en: Urology/pathology review the benign-leaning fibrous lesion and individualise follow-up; similar unoperated cases may merit further localisation and organ-preservation assessment without retrospectively asserting one mandatory operation here

feedback.zh-CN: IgG4计数、比例、形态与系统证据需合并判断；手术选择也受定位、恶性风险及可行性限制。
feedback.en: IgG4 count, ratio, morphology and systemic evidence must be integrated; operation choice depends on location, malignant risk and feasibility.

text.zh-CN: 仅IgG4细胞局部增多就确诊系统IgG4病并开始经验性免疫抑制
text.en: Local IgG4-positive cells alone diagnose systemic IgG4 disease and justify empirical immunosuppression

feedback.zh-CN: IgG4计数、比例、形态与系统证据需合并判断；手术选择也受定位、恶性风险及可行性限制。
feedback.en: IgG4 count, ratio, morphology and systemic evidence must be integrated; operation choice depends on location, malignant risk and feasibility.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病理倾向纤维性假瘤；术前不确定性、缺失标志物和IgG4证据限制必须保留。
conclusion.en: Pathology favoured fibrous pseudotumour; preoperative uncertainty, missing markers and limits of the IgG4 evidence must remain explicit.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 超声、CT与触诊的定位不完全一致，应核对原始影像。
keyReasoning.en: Ultrasound, CT and palpation do not localise the lesion identically and require correlation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正常或未升高标志物不能作为恶性肿瘤排除试验。
keyReasoning.en: Normal or non-elevated markers are not a rule-out test for malignancy.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.zh-CN: MRI/冰冻病理、AFP/LDH、激素参考区间、系统IgG4评估及长期功能结局。
unknowns.en: MRI/frozen section, AFP/LDH, hormone reference ranges, systemic IgG4 assessment and long-term functional outcome.
